extracted.name: Chipotle & lime dressing
extracted.description: Drizzle this chipotle and lime dressing over tacos or prawn-based salads. If you love Mexican chipotle chillies, this will soon become a favourite dressing
instruction_lines: Whisk the chipotle paste, lime juice and light olive oil together. Season to taste.
